dedupe_keys.name: conus near real time crop type mapper hls deep learning model and training data

description: This is a trained deep learning model and its training and test data for mapping crop types in near real time across the conterminous United States from Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) reflectance. The Zenodo record says the model file is in h5 format, inputs are two-year Landsat and Sentinel-2 time series of up to 176 dates each with 13 spectral and date features, outputs are 50 classes mapped back to Cropland Data Layer codes, and the code and normalisation files are on GitHub. It was published in January 2025 by Hankui Zhang and Yu Shen of South Dakota State University under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download (model about 70 MB, training data about 5.7 GB and an HLS and CDL time series archive of about 8.4 GB). Coverage is the conterminous United States. Caveats: the paper was in review, and labels depend on the Cropland Data Layer. For simulation it gives in-season crop type maps to estimate crop exposure to drought, flood or hail before official maps appear. Related catalogue records include the USDA Cropland Data Layer and the Corn Soy Data Layer.
inputs: HLS Landsat and Sentinel-2 reflectance time series
name: CONUS near real-time crop type mapper (HLS deep learning model and training data)
outputs: crop type class per pixel (50 CDL-based classes)
